Three dimensional mobjects

Source: R/three_dimensions.R
three_dimensions.Rd

  • ThreeDVMobject(): a VMobject() with shade_in_3d = TRUE.

  • Surface(func, u_range, v_range, resolution): a parametric surface func(u, v) (returning a length 3 point) made of checkerboard faces. set_fill_by_checkerboard(...) recolors the faces and set_fill_by_value(axes, colorscale, axis) colors them by a coordinate (axis 1, 2 or 3 for x, y, z).

  • Sphere(), Dot3D(), Cone(), Cylinder(), Line3D(), Arrow3D() and Torus() are surfaces; Cube() and Prism() are groups of square faces.

Usage

ThreeDVMobject(shade_in_3d = TRUE, ...)

Surface(
  func = NULL,
  u_range = c(0, 1),
  v_range = c(0, 1),
  resolution = 32,
  surface_piece_config = list(),
  fill_color = BLUE_D,
  fill_opacity = 1,
  checkerboard_colors = c(BLUE_D, BLUE_E),
  stroke_color = LIGHT_GREY,
  stroke_width = 0.5,
  should_make_jagged = FALSE,
  pre_function_handle_to_anchor_scale_factor = 1e-05,
  ...
)

Sphere(
  center = ORIGIN,
  radius = 1,
  resolution = NULL,
  u_range = c(0, TAU),
  v_range = c(0, PI),
  ...
)

Dot3D(
  point = ORIGIN,
  radius = DEFAULT_DOT_RADIUS,
  color = WHITE,
  resolution = c(8, 8),
  ...
)

Cube(
  side_length = 2,
  fill_opacity = 0.75,
  fill_color = BLUE,
  stroke_width = 0,
  ...
)

Prism(dimensions = c(3, 2, 1), ...)

Cone(
  base_radius = 1,
  height = 1,
  direction = Z_AXIS,
  show_base = FALSE,
  v_range = c(0, TAU),
  u_min = 0,
  checkerboard_colors = FALSE,
  ...
)

Cylinder(
  radius = 1,
  height = 2,
  direction = Z_AXIS,
  v_range = c(0, TAU),
  show_ends = TRUE,
  resolution = c(24, 24),
  ...
)

Line3D(
  start = LEFT,
  end = RIGHT,
  thickness = 0.02,
  color = NULL,
  resolution = 24,
  ...
)

Line3D_parallel_to(line, point = ORIGIN, length = 5, cls = Line3D, ...)

Line3D_perpendicular_to(line, point = ORIGIN, length = 5, cls = Line3D, ...)

Arrow3D(
  start = LEFT,
  end = RIGHT,
  thickness = 0.02,
  height = 0.3,
  base_radius = 0.08,
  color = WHITE,
  resolution = 24,
  ...
)

Torus(
  major_radius = 3,
  minor_radius = 1,
  u_range = c(0, TAU),
  v_range = c(0, TAU),
  resolution = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

shade_in_3d

Shade the faces according to their orientation to the light source.

...

Other named arguments, passed to VMobject().

func

Function of (u, v) returning a point.

u_range, v_range

Ranges c(min, max) of the u and v parameters.

resolution

Number of faces along u and v: one value or c(u, v); NULL uses the class default.

surface_piece_config

List of extra arguments for each face.

fill_color, fill_opacity

Fill color and opacity of the faces.

checkerboard_colors

Colors alternated across the faces; FALSE keeps fill_color.

stroke_color, stroke_width

Color and width of the face outlines.

should_make_jagged

Change the anchor mode of the curves from smooth to jagged.

pre_function_handle_to_anchor_scale_factor

Kept for compatibility with Manim.

center, radius

Center and radius of a sphere, dot or cylinder.

point

Center of the dot; for Line3D_parallel_to() and Line3D_perpendicular_to(), the point the new line passes through.

color

Color of the mobject.

side_length

Side length of the cube.

dimensions

Side lengths of the prism along x, y and z.

base_radius

Radius of the base of a cone or arrow tip.

height

Height of a cone or cylinder, or length of the arrow tip.

direction

Direction the cone or cylinder points along.

show_base

Draw the base disc of the cone.

u_min

Radius at the apex of the cone.

show_ends

Draw the end caps of the cylinder.

start, end

Start and end points of the line or arrow; they may be mobjects.

thickness

Thickness of the line or arrow shaft.

line

A Line3D().

length

Length of the new line.

cls

Constructor for the new line.

major_radius, minor_radius

Distance from the center of the torus to the center of its tube, and the radius of the tube.

Value

A mobject: an R6 object of the class named by the function called. The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.

Details

Line3D_parallel_to() and Line3D_perpendicular_to() port the upstream class methods Line3D.parallel_to() and Line3D.perpendicular_to(): a line of length through point.

Examples

s <- Sphere(radius = 1.5, resolution = c(12, 6))
cube <- Cube(side_length = 2, fill_color = RED)
surf <- Surface(function(u, v) c(u, v, sin(u) * cos(v)),
                u_range = c(-2, 2), v_range = c(-2, 2), resolution = 8)
